# Data Source: stripe_entitlements_feature

A feature a product can grant, identified by a unique `lookup_key`. `terraform destroy` archives the feature, because Stripe cannot delete one. An archived feature cannot be updated or reactivated, and its `lookup_key` cannot be used again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stripe_entitlements_feature" "by_id" {
  id = stripe_entitlements_feature.advanced_search.id
}

data "stripe_entitlements_feature" "by_lookup_key" {
  lookup_key = "advanced_search"
}
```

## Argument Reference

This data source supports the following arguments:

Exactly one must be set.

* `id` - (Optional) Unique identifier for the object.
* `lookup_key` - (Optional) A unique key you provide as your own system identifier. This may be up to 80 characters.

## Attribute Reference

This data source exports the following attributes in addition to the arguments above:

* `active` - Inactive features cannot be attached to new products and will not be returned from the features list endpoint.
* `livemode` - If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.
* `metadata` - Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format.
* `name` - The feature's name, for your own purpose, not meant to be displayable to the customer.
